staff.name: Daniella Torres
staff.description:
Hi Gorgeous 🩷 
I'm Dani, a licensed esthetician with 3+ years of experience in the lash industry. I’m a 2x certified lash technician servicing lash extensions, natural lash enhancements, and brow lamination and tint. My expertise lies in creating volume and wet set lashes, aiming for natural appearances to enhance your beauty effortlessly.

When you come in, I’m all about making you feel comfortable, confident, and relaxed. My goal is to deliver a personalized experience that leaves you feeling like your best self: no stress, just beauty.

Text me at 727-310-6460 for any questions before booking your appointment. Please be sure to check out our Instagram @eyeconicbeautylounge___ for inspo pics and a closer look at my work!

Thank you for choosing me for your beauty needs - I hope to see you soon 🩷✨
